comments.body: I'd like to briefly cover https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/869 , clarifying behavior for undecodable BALs.

- consensus-specs #[5576](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5576) — Derive MAX_SIGNED_INCLUSION_LIST_SIZE from transaction byte bound (41112 + non-empty rule)
- execution-apis #[870](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/870) — engine getInclusionListV1 bound = sum of tx byte lengths, no empty txs

I would like to discuss this extra gossip check for bids we should add:

* https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5580
